Major changes to Annex A were made as follows:
- Part 9-1: the temperature limits for selected material types were changed.
- Part 9-2: the permissible noise level at corridors was increased.
- Part 9-3: the required displacement was reduced.
- Part 9-4: the multiplied energy is now normalized on the factor 2.
- Part 9-5: the performance category of the housing assembly for windows was changed from Category "A" to Category "B".
- Part 9-6: no new information was added.
- In particular, Category "D" has been abolished completely.
- The information maximum value for sound power (SPL) has been left unchanged.

The basic principles of a new EN standard for acoustic comfort for buildings (CEN/EN 1628-1 (2008-11)) "Standard EN 1628-1:2008: Determination of acoustic comfort for buildings" is available on the web. This standard will replace all other national standards in Europe.

**CEN/TC148** is preparing the acoustics part of the standard. Its next work group (WG12) is preparing three multidisciplinary sub-groups:
- Monitoring and characterization of the acoustic environment in buildings,
- Modeling of acoustic situation in buildings, and
- Assessment of acoustic comfort. WG12 is preparing a draft CEN/TC148 draft recommendation for the next meeting.
In addition, a working group of WG12 On behalf of the CEN/TC148 working group on "Climate change" the first meeting of the working group was held in October 2022.

The ISO 11363 standard for measurement of sound pressure levels under stepped conditions (ISO 11363-2:2021) was developed and implemented in CEN/TC117 in 2017. In December 2020, a working group of CEN/TC117 started developing the standard. The next meeting of the group will be in October 2022.

More information on acoustics for the CEN/TC117 task group Acoustics.
